about.title: About Tuty Packers
about.subtitle: A Thoothukudi business built on referrals, repeat customers and a trusted transport network.
about.founderBio: Jenil Brighten built Tuty Packers on referrals and reliability — matching every move with the right vehicle from our trusted transport network.
about.story: We started small — a single truck, a couple of drivers, and a list of customers who'd call back. Word travelled faster than the trucks did. Today we tap a trusted network of transport partners for any vehicle size, and the list of phone numbers that ring the moment a move is planned keeps growing.
about.fleetBody: We work only with vetted, trusted transport partners across Thoothukudi. Whatever the load — a single carton or a full house — we match it to the right vehicle size, so you never pay for more truck than you need.
about.valuesBody: Upfront quotes. Honest ETAs. Real people on the phone at 2am when a long-haul needs to roll. Every transport partner we work with is vetted by us — you deal with one point of contact, start to finish.
